verdict.rationale: Snyk's docs reference risk-based prioritization, a risk score combining prevalence/ease-of-fix, and 'policy management' as a plan feature, implying severity/confidence-based gating exists, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a severity-threshold or confidence-based CI gate flag. Community feedback (snyk-comm-9, snyk-comm-10) suggests low-severity findings still create noise and confusion, undercutting full delivery.
